test.message: What is the maximum conference registration fee I can claim?
test.events: VERSION_FILTER:3 superseded sections excluded;CONFLICT:KB-03 §5 vs KB-01 §4 on registration_cap
test.answer: The documents disagree on this. Faculty Seed Grant Guidelines 2025 says: "Registration fees for domestic conferences may be charged to the seed grant up to ₹40,000 per conference." [KB-03 §5]. TA/DA Rules for Faculty (Handbook) says: "Registration fees for domestic conferences may be reimbursed up to ₹30,000 per conference, on production of the receipt and proof of attendance." [KB-01 §4]. I've flagged the conflict to the Accounts Section; until they confirm, plan on the lower figure.
